findings.title: Reject truncated CBOR byte/text strings
findings.evidence: Major bytes/text returns stream.read(val) without requiring len == val. loads also returns after one item without checking trailing data. Static example: 0x43 followed by one byte returns that one byte although length says three.
findings.impact: Malformed serialized input is accepted as a different value; strict framing and integrity callers cannot rely on decoder rejection.

findings.title: Check arithmetic overflow at the C ABI boundary
findings.evidence: b60_sexa_add performs f1 + f2 and s1 + s2 + carry as unchecked u64 additions and returns 0; API accepts arbitrary u64 arguments with no numeric preconditions.
findings.trigger: For example s1=u64::MAX, s2=1 with valid output pointers.
findings.impact: Release arithmetic can wrap while reporting exact addition success; overflow-checked builds panic across extern C and may abort the embedding process.

findings.title: Compute the actual repository root in setup
findings.evidence: SCRIPT_DIR is scripts/c5_setup, and a single dirname sets REPO_ROOT to scripts. Consequently line 24 looks for scripts/.agents rather than repository .agents, then skips copying and prints success at line 42.
findings.trigger: Run the setup script at its committed location.
findings.impact: The advertised governance/skill installation silently fails.

findings.title: Label simulated receipts as simulated, without hardware identity
findings.evidence: trigger_biometric_gate never calls the swift_gate path. It generates an HMAC from a fixed source constant but writes status ATTESTED_BY_OPERATOR and mechanism SECURE_ENCLAVE_P256_LOCAL. execute_cycle consumes True and writes COMMITTED receipts to the demo sitrep.
findings.trigger: Execute the supplied demo critical task.
findings.impact: The example exports false operator/hardware attestation evidence. Only demo state and sitrep consumers were found; this is not evidence of a production authorization bypass.

findings.title: Do not certify empirical survival from keyword templates
findings.evidence: Every extract_meta branch selects preset SURVIVE postulates; metrics use line count and unique word ratio. Output unconditionally declares POPPERIAN_SURVIVED and claims empirical scrutiny at line 96, with no experiment or source verification.
findings.trigger: Process any input post matched by the batch slice.
findings.impact: Generated audit documents present predetermined assertions and heuristic scores as checked evidence.

findings.title: Bind field names and types into the evidence seal
findings.evidence: compute_merkle_root hashes only str(val) or serialized container values, then sorts leaf hashes. Keys are excluded and order is discarded. For example {author:A,text:B} and {author:B,text:A} yield the same leaf multiset; scalar 1 and string 1 also have identical leaf bytes. Main inserts this root as merkle_seal at lines 2935–2940.
findings.trigger: Swap two scalar values between evidence fields, rename a field, or change a scalar type while retaining its string representation.
findings.impact: The advertised evidence seal cannot detect semantic tampering with field associations or scalar types.

findings.title: Namespace vault record IDs by platform and instance
findings.evidence: save_to_vault selects data.id as record_id, table defines record_id alone as PRIMARY KEY, and INSERT OR REPLACE discards the existing record. Mastodon fetch_status emits status_id as id (line 1909) without instance namespace.
findings.trigger: Save two statuses with the same local numeric ID from different Mastodon instances into the shared vault.
findings.impact: The second capture silently replaces the first source record and its forensic content.

findings.title: Use a unique temporary audio file for each synthesis
findings.evidence: Each invocation writes /tmp/f5_raw_synthesis.wav before launching ffmpeg against that same path; no exclusive creation, per-run directory or cleanup protects it.
findings.trigger: Two syntheses overlap after one writes its audio and before its ffmpeg has read it.
findings.impact: An output may contain another synthesis audio, or a concurrent write may corrupt conversion; the fixed file also retains synthesized speech.

findings.title: Avoid treating missing failure logs as proof of all invariants
findings.evidence: Tutorial states that absence of CRITICAL HALT in a log is positive proof that execution maintained all invariants. No completeness or trusted monitoring premise accompanies the claim.
findings.trigger: Use tutorial guidance to accept an incomplete log or a run with an uninstrumented defect.
findings.impact: Readers are instructed to certify correctness from absence of an error message, exceeding the evidence supplied.

findings.title: Emit a valid JSON container for batch output
findings.evidence: For --format json each item is json.dumps(extracted_data), but final_output joins all_reports with a Markdown separator. The --batch option can produce two or more items.
findings.trigger: Run a batch with at least two successfully extracted URLs and --format json.
findings.impact: Output is not a JSON document and cannot be parsed by downstream JSON tooling.

findings.title: Do not label watch-page text as an audio transcript
findings.evidence: YouTubeAdapter fetches the video watch URL through r.jina.ai, puts the entire first 10000 body characters into transcript_text, and reports it under Transcripción de Audio at line 2301. No captions or audio transcription stage exists in the adapter.
findings.trigger: Fetch a video through this adapter.
findings.impact: Page metadata and unrelated watch-page text can be presented and analyzed as words spoken in the video.

findings.title: Label regex matches as candidate facts rather than verified facts
findings.evidence: EpistemicClassifier matches references such as RFC, sha256 or a legal keyword and increments hechos_verificados, which the Markdown report renders as Hechos Verificados at line 2462. There is no source retrieval, evidence validation or truth check in classify_text.
findings.trigger: Classify a false sentence that includes a matching reference keyword.
findings.impact: The report presents unverified textual claims as verified evidence.

hypotheses.claim: Static proof obligations count allocations/frees without ordering, use-after-free or unknown frees; a balanced but misordered AST may still produce proven counts.
hypotheses.status: Not claimed as a runtime bypass: targeted symbol search found no compiler consumer of this generator beyond its local test; additional integration tracing required.

coverage.note: All source lines read in untruncated chunks of at most 200 lines; source-only review.
